title: Perfect complexes generate the quasi-coherent derived category
statement: For every quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme X [def-pc-scheme], the smallest strictly full subcategory of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] that contains every perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] and is closed under shifts, cones, retracts, and arbitrary set-indexed direct sums is all of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X).
